item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00456","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C15","C01","C23"],"selected_candidate_label":"C15","confidence":0.86,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C15 plausibly supplied a material drafting template for the child’s council machinery. Both establish a body composed of agency representatives designated by agency heads, provide for alternates, assign an advisory function, authorize committees, and require a host department to furnish facilities or support. This unusually close cluster of provisions goes beyond the generic act of creating an advisory body. C01 and C23 share portions of the same structure, but neither matches as many concrete elements in combination.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Council shall be composed of one qualified representative of each of the several executive departments and agencies... Such representatives shall be designated by the heads of the respective departments and agencies, who may also designate suitable alternate representatives.","parent_excerpt":"A Government Patents Board is established consisting of... one representative from each of the following... Each such representative, together with an alternate, shall be designated by the head of the agency concerned.","explanation":"The membership mechanism closely tracks agency representatives selected by agency heads together with designated alternates."},{"child_excerpt":"The Council shall advise the Secretary of Labor...","parent_excerpt":"The Government Patents Board shall advise and confer with the Chairman...","explanation":"Both bodies are constituted principally to advise the official administering the relevant government-wide program."},{"child_excerpt":"The Council may... establish such committees as it finds necessary for carrying out its functions.","parent_excerpt":"The Chairman shall establish such committees and other working groups as may be required to advise or assist him in the performance of any of his functions.","explanation":"Both expressly use subsidiary committees as administrative machinery for performing the body’s functions."},{"child_excerpt":"The Secretary of Labor is hereby authorized and directed to provide... such staff and other services and supplies as may be required by the Council...","parent_excerpt":"The Department of Commerce shall provide necessary office accommodations and facilities for the use of the Board and the Chairman.","explanation":"Each assigns the hosting department responsibility for the advisory body’s operational support."}]}
